scenarios.label: bull
scenarios.drivers: Delivery beat of ~10% (within observed single-quarter swing range) AND the market continues to pay Tesla's own 5-year median NTM EV/Sales multiple (11.50x) — a persistence, not an expansion, of history [02_multiples-own-history.md §2; 07_scenario-and-fair-value.md §3]

derivation.net_debt_basis: broad — total debt $16,080mm minus cash & ST investments $43,524mm [01_price-and-capital-structure.md §4]

scenarios.label: base
scenarios.drivers: Consensus NTM revenue is delivered; the market re-prices Tesla toward what its disclosed economics (peer-comparable margin/growth/leverage edge, no proven moat) warrant, rather than continuing to price unmonetized robotaxi/Optimus/FSD optionality [07_scenario-and-fair-value.md §3]

derivation.net_debt_basis: broad — total debt $16,080mm minus cash & ST investments $43,524mm [01_price-and-capital-structure.md §4]

scenarios.label: bear
scenarios.drivers: Structural reset (headline bear, worse of two bear inputs): business-model/09_moat.md finds 'No moat proven' AND an explicitly 'eroding' trajectory (ROIC fell every year for 3 straight years), tripping the CLAUDE.md §24 Filter-5 structural-reset requirement. Uses 04_intrinsic-dcf.md's own declining/runoff terminal: terminal EBIT margin fades to 5.0% (below the 8.5% base-case terminal margin), D&A 8.0% of revenue, capex 6.5% of revenue, g=1.0% [04_intrinsic-dcf.md §5]. A secondary, less severe cyclical-trough bear ($20.90/share: NTM revenue $88,688mm x 0.70x NTM EV/Sales) is shown in the markdown as the nearer-term 12-month marker but is not the headline.

derivation.net_debt_basis: strict — 07_scenario-and-fair-value.md §3 bear-case bridge note (departs from the broad top-level basis; this scenario is bridged per 01's canonical strict net-debt anchor since it is an EV-based structural reset, not an already-equity multiple)
